<?php

/* Shared helpers for credit control: reviews, holds, overdue reminders, late payment charges and write-offs.

Hold states live in holdreasons.dissallowinvoices: 0 = invoicing allowed, 1 = on hold (no new invoices),
2 = watch (staff are warned but can carry on). A customer's state is the state of its hold reason. */

// the security token that lets a user hold, release and change limits (Credit Control)
define('CREDIT_CONTROL_TOKEN', 21);

function CreditControlUser() {
	return isset($_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']) and in_array(CREDIT_CONTROL_TOKEN, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* True when the person logged in is a customer (the same test session.php uses) */
function CreditCustomerLogin() {
	global $CustomerLogin;
	return !empty($CustomerLogin);
}

/* SQL to add to a WHERE clause of a list of customers so that salespeople only see their own customers */
function CreditSalesmanCustomerSQL($DebtorField = 'debtorsmaster.debtorno') {
	if (isset($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin']) and $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] != '') {
		return " AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM custbranch
							WHERE custbranch.debtorno=" . $DebtorField . "
							AND custbranch.salesman='" . $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] . "')";
	}
	if (CreditCustomerLogin()) {
		return " AND " . $DebtorField . "='" . $_SESSION['CustomerID'] . "'";
	}
	return '';
}

/* SQL to add to a WHERE clause of a list of customer transactions so that salespeople only see their own */
function CreditSalesmanTransSQL($TransAlias = 'debtortrans') {
	if (isset($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin']) and $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] != '') {
		return " AND " . $TransAlias . ".salesperson='" . $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] . "'";
	}
	if (CreditCustomerLogin()) {
		return " AND " . $TransAlias . ".debtorno='" . $_SESSION['CustomerID'] . "'";
	}
	return '';
}

/* Can the person logged in see credit information about this customer? */
function CreditCanSeeCustomer($DebtorNo) {
	if (CreditCustomerLogin()) {
		return $DebtorNo == $_SESSION['CustomerID'];
	}
	if (isset($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin']) and $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] != '') {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM custbranch
							WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'
							AND salesman='" . $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] . "'");
		$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
		return $MyRow[0] > 0;
	}
	return true;
}

/* Customers can only see their own reminders and charges, not the internal reviews */
function CreditCanSeeReviews() {
	return !CreditCustomerLogin();
}

function CreditReviewOutcomes() {
	return array('kept' => __('Limit kept'),
				'raised' => __('Limit raised'),
				'lowered' => __('Limit lowered'),
				'hold' => __('Account put on hold'),
				'release' => __('Account released from hold'),
				'watch' => __('Account put on watch'));
}

function CreditReviewIntervalDays() {
	if (isset($_SESSION['CreditReviewIntervalDays']) and $_SESSION['CreditReviewIntervalDays'] > 0) {
		return (int)$_SESSION['CreditReviewIntervalDays'];
	}
	return 365;
}

/* The date, in SQL format, a customer's first review falls due when the customer is created without one */
function CreditDefaultReviewDate() {
	return date('Y-m-d', strtotime('+' . CreditReviewIntervalDays() . ' days'));
}

function CreditHoldState($Dissallow) {
	if ($Dissallow == 1) {
		return 'hold';
	} elseif ($Dissallow == 2) {
		return 'watch';
	}
	return 'ok';
}

/* The hold state of a customer, read from the database every time so no session copy can be stale.
Returns array('state' => ok|watch|hold, 'reason' => text, 'name' => customer name) or false if the customer is unknown. */
function CreditCustomerState($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT holdreasons.dissallowinvoices,
								holdreasons.reasondescription,
								debtorsmaster.name
						FROM debtorsmaster
						INNER JOIN holdreasons ON debtorsmaster.holdreason=holdreasons.reasoncode
						WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	return array('state' => CreditHoldState($MyRow['dissallowinvoices']),
				'reason' => $MyRow['reasondescription'],
				'name' => $MyRow['name']);
}

/* Gate used by every route that creates or invoices an order. Returns an empty string when the customer may be
invoiced, otherwise the reason. A customer on watch is allowed, with a warning displayed unless $Silent. */
function CreditInvoicingBlock($DebtorNo, $Silent = false) {
	$State = CreditCustomerState($DebtorNo);
	if ($State === false) {
		return '';
	}
	if ($State['state'] == 'hold') {
		return __('The account of') . ' ' . $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $State['name'] . ' ' . __('is on hold') . ' (' . $State['reason'] . ') - ' . __('no invoices can be raised for it. Please contact the credit control personnel');
	}
	if ($State['state'] == 'watch' and !$Silent) {
		prnMsg(__('The account of') . ' ' . $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $State['name'] . ' ' . __('is on watch') . ' (' . $State['reason'] . ') - ' . __('please check with the credit control personnel before extending more credit'), 'warn');
	}
	return '';
}

/* SQL boolean expression: the transaction is due, exactly as the invoice, statement, customer inquiry and aged debtors report age it */
function CreditDueSQL($TransAlias = 'debtortrans', $TermsAlias = 'paymentterms') {
	return "(CASE WHEN " . $TermsAlias . ".daysbeforedue > 0
				THEN (TO_DAYS(Now()) - TO_DAYS(" . $TransAlias . ".trandate)) >= " . $TermsAlias . ".daysbeforedue
				ELSE (TO_DAYS(Now()) - TO_DAYS(ADDDATE(last_day(" . $TransAlias . ".trandate), " . $TermsAlias . ".dayinfollowingmonth))) >= 0
			END)";
}

/* SQL boolean expression: the transaction is in an overdue band ($Days is PastDueDays1 or PastDueDays2), same rule as the reports */
function CreditOverdueBandSQL($Days, $TransAlias = 'debtortrans', $TermsAlias = 'paymentterms') {
	$Days = (int)$Days;
	return "(CASE WHEN " . $TermsAlias . ".daysbeforedue > 0
				THEN ((TO_DAYS(Now()) - TO_DAYS(" . $TransAlias . ".trandate)) > " . $TermsAlias . ".daysbeforedue
					AND (TO_DAYS(Now()) - TO_DAYS(" . $TransAlias . ".trandate)) >= (" . $TermsAlias . ".daysbeforedue + " . $Days . "))
				ELSE (TO_DAYS(Now()) - TO_DAYS(ADDDATE(last_day(" . $TransAlias . ".trandate), " . $TermsAlias . ".dayinfollowingmonth))) >= " . $Days . "
			END)";
}

/* SQL expression giving the reminder level a transaction has reached: 0 not due, 1 past due (friendly),
2 first overdue band (firm), 3 second overdue band (final notice) */
function CreditReminderLevelSQL($TransAlias = 'debtortrans', $TermsAlias = 'paymentterms') {
	return "(CASE WHEN " . CreditOverdueBandSQL($_SESSION['PastDueDays2'], $TransAlias, $TermsAlias) . " THEN 3
				WHEN " . CreditOverdueBandSQL($_SESSION['PastDueDays1'], $TransAlias, $TermsAlias) . " THEN 2
				WHEN " . CreditDueSQL($TransAlias, $TermsAlias) . " THEN 1
				ELSE 0 END)";
}

/* SQL expression for the date a transaction fell due */
function CreditDueDateSQL($TransAlias = 'debtortrans', $TermsAlias = 'paymentterms') {
	return "(CASE WHEN " . $TermsAlias . ".daysbeforedue > 0
				THEN DATE_ADD(" . $TransAlias . ".trandate, INTERVAL " . $TermsAlias . ".daysbeforedue DAY)
				ELSE ADDDATE(last_day(" . $TransAlias . ".trandate), " . $TermsAlias . ".dayinfollowingmonth)
			END)";
}

function CreditReminderLevelName($Level) {
	if ($Level == 3) {
		return __('Final notice');
	} elseif ($Level == 2) {
		return __('Firm reminder');
	}
	return __('Friendly reminder');
}

function CreditReminderText($Level) {
	$Key = 'ReminderText' . (int)$Level;
	if (isset($_SESSION[$Key]) and $_SESSION[$Key] != '') {
		return $_SESSION[$Key];
	}
	return '';
}

/* The company default accounts credit control posts to */
function CreditCompanyAccounts() {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorsact, latechargeact, baddebtact, salesexchangediffact, gllink_debtors, currencydefault
						FROM companies WHERE coycode=1");
	return DB_fetch_array($Result);
}

/* Is the account a usable ledger account (set and present in the chart)? */
function CreditAccountIsSet($AccountCode) {
	if ($AccountCode == '' or $AccountCode == '0') {
		return false;
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chartmaster WHERE accountcode='" . $AccountCode . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow[0] > 0;
}

/* Records a credit review and applies its effect on the customer in one transaction: the review row, and the new
limit, hold reason and next review date on the customer either all happen or none does (every query below rolls back and
stops the script on failure). All values are expected to be already escaped and dates in SQL format.
Returns an error message, or an empty string on success. */
function CreditSaveReview($DebtorNo, $Outcome, $NewLimit, $NewHoldReason, $ReviewDate, $NextReviewDate, $Comments) {
	if (!CreditControlUser()) {
		return __('Only credit control may record credit reviews');
	}
	$Outcomes = CreditReviewOutcomes();
	if (!isset($Outcomes[$Outcome])) {
		return __('The review outcome is not valid');
	}
	if ($NextReviewDate < $ReviewDate) {
		return __('The next review cannot be due before the date of this review');
	}

	$Result = DB_query("SELECT creditlimit, holdreason FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return __('The customer does not exist');
	}
	$Customer = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$OldLimit = $Customer['creditlimit'];
	$OldHold = $Customer['holdreason'];

	$ResultLimit = $OldLimit;
	$ResultHold = $OldHold;

	if ($Outcome == 'raised' or $Outcome == 'lowered') {
		if (!is_numeric($NewLimit) or $NewLimit < 0) {
			return __('The new credit limit must be a number that is not negative');
		}
		if ($Outcome == 'raised' and $NewLimit <= $OldLimit) {
			return __('A raised credit limit must be higher than the present limit');
		}
		if ($Outcome == 'lowered' and $NewLimit >= $OldLimit) {
			return __('A lowered credit limit must be lower than the present limit');
		}
		$ResultLimit = $NewLimit;
	}
	if ($Outcome == 'hold' or $Outcome == 'release' or $Outcome == 'watch') {
		$Wanted = array('hold' => 1, 'release' => 0, 'watch' => 2);
		$ReasonResult = DB_query("SELECT dissallowinvoices FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode='" . $NewHoldReason . "'");
		if (DB_num_rows($ReasonResult) == 0) {
			return __('The credit status chosen does not exist');
		}
		$ReasonRow = DB_fetch_row($ReasonResult);
		if ($ReasonRow[0] != $Wanted[$Outcome]) {
			return __('The credit status chosen does not match the outcome of the review');
		}
		$ResultHold = $NewHoldReason;
	}

	DB_Txn_Begin();
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditreviews (debtorno,
										reviewdate,
										userid,
										outcome,
										oldcreditlimit,
										newcreditlimit,
										oldholdreason,
										newholdreason,
										nextreviewdate,
										comments,
										inputdate)
								VALUES ('" . $DebtorNo . "',
										'" . $ReviewDate . "',
										'" . $_SESSION['UserID'] . "',
										'" . $Outcome . "',
										'" . $OldLimit . "',
										'" . $ResultLimit . "',
										'" . $OldHold . "',
										'" . $ResultHold . "',
										'" . $NextReviewDate . "',
										'" . $Comments . "',
										'" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The credit review could not be saved because'), '', true);

	$SQL = "UPDATE debtorsmaster SET creditlimit='" . $ResultLimit . "',
									holdreason='" . $ResultHold . "',
									nextreviewdate='" . $NextReviewDate . "'
			WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The customer account could not be updated by the credit review because'), '', true);
	DB_Txn_Commit();
	return '';
}

<?php

/* Shared helpers for credit control: reviews, holds, overdue reminders, late payment charges and write-offs.

Hold states live in holdreasons.dissallowinvoices: 0 = invoicing allowed, 1 = on hold (no new invoices),
2 = watch (staff are warned but can carry on). A customer's state is the state of its hold reason. */

// the security token that lets a user hold, release and change limits (Credit Control)
define('CREDIT_CONTROL_TOKEN', 21);

function CreditControlUser() {
	return isset($_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']) and in_array(CREDIT_CONTROL_TOKEN, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* True when the person logged in is a customer (the same test session.php uses) */
function CreditCustomerLogin() {
	global $CustomerLogin;
	return !empty($CustomerLogin);
}

/* SQL to add to a WHERE clause of a list of customers so that salespeople only see their own customers */
function CreditSalesmanCustomerSQL($DebtorField = 'debtorsmaster.debtorno') {
	if (isset($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin']) and $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] != '') {
		return " AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM custbranch
							WHERE custbranch.debtorno=" . $DebtorField . "
							AND custbranch.salesman='" . $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] . "')";
	}
	if (CreditCustomerLogin()) {
		return " AND " . $DebtorField . "='" . $_SESSION['CustomerID'] . "'";
	}
	return '';
}

/* SQL to add to a WHERE clause of a list of customer transactions so that salespeople only see their own */
function CreditSalesmanTransSQL($TransAlias = 'debtortrans') {
	if (isset($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin']) and $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] != '') {
		return " AND " . $TransAlias . ".salesperson='" . $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] . "'";
	}
	if (CreditCustomerLogin()) {
		return " AND " . $TransAlias . ".debtorno='" . $_SESSION['CustomerID'] . "'";
	}
	return '';
}

/* Can the person logged in see credit information about this customer? */
function CreditCanSeeCustomer($DebtorNo) {
	if (CreditCustomerLogin()) {
		return $DebtorNo == $_SESSION['CustomerID'];
	}
	if (isset($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin']) and $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] != '') {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM custbranch
							WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'
							AND salesman='" . $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] . "'");
		$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
		return $MyRow[0] > 0;
	}
	return true;
}

/* Customers can only see their own reminders and charges, not the internal reviews */
function CreditCanSeeReviews() {
	return !CreditCustomerLogin();
}

function CreditReviewOutcomes() {
	return array('kept' => __('Limit kept'),
				'raised' => __('Limit raised'),
				'lowered' => __('Limit lowered'),
				'hold' => __('Account put on hold'),
				'release' => __('Account released from hold'),
				'watch' => __('Account put on watch'));
}

function CreditReviewIntervalDays() {
	if (isset($_SESSION['CreditReviewIntervalDays']) and $_SESSION['CreditReviewIntervalDays'] > 0) {
		return (int)$_SESSION['CreditReviewIntervalDays'];
	}
	return 365;
}

/* The date, in SQL format, a customer's first review falls due when the customer is created without one */
function CreditDefaultReviewDate() {
	return date('Y-m-d', strtotime('+' . CreditReviewIntervalDays() . ' days'));
}

function CreditHoldState($Dissallow) {
	if ($Dissallow == 1) {
		return 'hold';
	} elseif ($Dissallow == 2) {
		return 'watch';
	}
	return 'ok';
}

/* The hold state of a customer, read from the database every time so no session copy can be stale.
Returns array('state' => ok|watch|hold, 'reason' => text, 'name' => customer name) or false if the customer is unknown. */
function CreditCustomerState($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT holdreasons.dissallowinvoices,
								holdreasons.reasondescription,
								debtorsmaster.name
						FROM debtorsmaster
						INNER JOIN holdreasons ON debtorsmaster.holdreason=holdreasons.reasoncode
						WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	return array('state' => CreditHoldState($MyRow['dissallowinvoices']),
				'reason' => $MyRow['reasondescription'],
				'name' => $MyRow['name']);
}

/* Gate used by every route that creates or invoices an order. Returns an empty string when the customer may be
invoiced, otherwise the reason. A customer on watch is allowed, with a warning displayed unless $Silent. */
function CreditInvoicingBlock($DebtorNo, $Silent = false) {
	$State = CreditCustomerState($DebtorNo);
	if ($State === false) {
		return '';
	}
	if ($State['state'] == 'hold') {
		return __('The account of') . ' ' . $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $State['name'] . ' ' . __('is on hold') . ' (' . $State['reason'] . ') - ' . __('no invoices can be raised for it. Please contact the credit control personnel');
	}
	if ($State['state'] == 'watch' and !$Silent) {
		prnMsg(__('The account of') . ' ' . $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $State['name'] . ' ' . __('is on watch') . ' (' . $State['reason'] . ') - ' . __('please check with the credit control personnel before extending more credit'), 'warn');
	}
	return '';
}

/* SQL boolean expression: the transaction is due, exactly as the invoice, statement, customer inquiry and aged debtors report age it */
function CreditDueSQL($TransAlias = 'debtortrans', $TermsAlias = 'paymentterms') {
	return "(CASE WHEN " . $TermsAlias . ".daysbeforedue > 0
				THEN (TO_DAYS(Now()) - TO_DAYS(" . $TransAlias . ".trandate)) >= " . $TermsAlias . ".daysbeforedue
				ELSE (TO_DAYS(Now()) - TO_DAYS(ADDDATE(last_day(" . $TransAlias . ".trandate), " . $TermsAlias . ".dayinfollowingmonth))) >= 0
			END)";
}

/* SQL boolean expression: the transaction is in an overdue band ($Days is PastDueDays1 or PastDueDays2), same rule as the reports */
function CreditOverdueBandSQL($Days, $TransAlias = 'debtortrans', $TermsAlias = 'paymentterms') {
	$Days = (int)$Days;
	return "(CASE WHEN " . $TermsAlias . ".daysbeforedue > 0
				THEN ((TO_DAYS(Now()) - TO_DAYS(" . $TransAlias . ".trandate)) > " . $TermsAlias . ".daysbeforedue
					AND (TO_DAYS(Now()) - TO_DAYS(" . $TransAlias . ".trandate)) >= (" . $TermsAlias . ".daysbeforedue + " . $Days . "))
				ELSE (TO_DAYS(Now()) - TO_DAYS(ADDDATE(last_day(" . $TransAlias . ".trandate), " . $TermsAlias . ".dayinfollowingmonth))) >= " . $Days . "
			END)";
}

/* SQL expression giving the reminder level a transaction has reached: 0 not due, 1 past due (friendly),
2 first overdue band (firm), 3 second overdue band (final notice) */
function CreditReminderLevelSQL($TransAlias = 'debtortrans', $TermsAlias = 'paymentterms') {
	return "(CASE WHEN " . CreditOverdueBandSQL($_SESSION['PastDueDays2'], $TransAlias, $TermsAlias) . " THEN 3
				WHEN " . CreditOverdueBandSQL($_SESSION['PastDueDays1'], $TransAlias, $TermsAlias) . " THEN 2
				WHEN " . CreditDueSQL($TransAlias, $TermsAlias) . " THEN 1
				ELSE 0 END)";
}

/* SQL expression for the date a transaction fell due */
function CreditDueDateSQL($TransAlias = 'debtortrans', $TermsAlias = 'paymentterms') {
	return "(CASE WHEN " . $TermsAlias . ".daysbeforedue > 0
				THEN DATE_ADD(" . $TransAlias . ".trandate, INTERVAL " . $TermsAlias . ".daysbeforedue DAY)
				ELSE ADDDATE(last_day(" . $TransAlias . ".trandate), " . $TermsAlias . ".dayinfollowingmonth)
			END)";
}

function CreditReminderLevelName($Level) {
	if ($Level == 3) {
		return __('Final notice');
	} elseif ($Level == 2) {
		return __('Firm reminder');
	}
	return __('Friendly reminder');
}

function CreditReminderText($Level) {
	$Key = 'ReminderText' . (int)$Level;
	if (isset($_SESSION[$Key]) and $_SESSION[$Key] != '') {
		return $_SESSION[$Key];
	}
	return '';
}

/* The company default accounts credit control posts to */
function CreditCompanyAccounts() {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorsact, latechargeact, baddebtact, salesexchangediffact, gllink_debtors, currencydefault
						FROM companies WHERE coycode=1");
	return DB_fetch_array($Result);
}

/* Is the account a usable ledger account (set and present in the chart)? */
function CreditAccountIsSet($AccountCode) {
	if ($AccountCode == '' or $AccountCode == '0') {
		return false;
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chartmaster WHERE accountcode='" . $AccountCode . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow[0] > 0;
}

/* Records a credit review and applies its effect on the customer in one transaction: the review row, and the new
limit, hold reason and next review date on the customer either all happen or none does (every query below rolls back and
stops the script on failure). All values are expected to be already escaped and dates in SQL format.
Returns an error message, or an empty string on success. */
function CreditSaveReview($DebtorNo, $Outcome, $NewLimit, $NewHoldReason, $ReviewDate, $NextReviewDate, $Comments) {
	if (!CreditControlUser()) {
		return __('Only credit control may record credit reviews');
	}
	$Outcomes = CreditReviewOutcomes();
	if (!isset($Outcomes[$Outcome])) {
		return __('The review outcome is not valid');
	}
	if ($NextReviewDate < $ReviewDate) {
		return __('The next review cannot be due before the date of this review');
	}

	$Result = DB_query("SELECT creditlimit, holdreason FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return __('The customer does not exist');
	}
	$Customer = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$OldLimit = $Customer['creditlimit'];
	$OldHold = $Customer['holdreason'];

	$ResultLimit = $OldLimit;
	$ResultHold = $OldHold;

	if ($Outcome == 'raised' or $Outcome == 'lowered') {
		if (!is_numeric($NewLimit) or $NewLimit < 0) {
			return __('The new credit limit must be a number that is not negative');
		}
		if ($Outcome == 'raised' and $NewLimit <= $OldLimit) {
			return __('A raised credit limit must be higher than the present limit');
		}
		if ($Outcome == 'lowered' and $NewLimit >= $OldLimit) {
			return __('A lowered credit limit must be lower than the present limit');
		}
		$ResultLimit = $NewLimit;
	}
	if ($Outcome == 'hold' or $Outcome == 'release' or $Outcome == 'watch') {
		$Wanted = array('hold' => 1, 'release' => 0, 'watch' => 2);
		$ReasonResult = DB_query("SELECT dissallowinvoices FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode='" . $NewHoldReason . "'");
		if (DB_num_rows($ReasonResult) == 0) {
			return __('The credit status chosen does not exist');
		}
		$ReasonRow = DB_fetch_row($ReasonResult);
		if ($ReasonRow[0] != $Wanted[$Outcome]) {
			return __('The credit status chosen does not match the outcome of the review');
		}
		$ResultHold = $NewHoldReason;
	}

	DB_Txn_Begin();
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditreviews (debtorno,
										reviewdate,
										userid,
										outcome,
										oldcreditlimit,
										newcreditlimit,
										oldholdreason,
										newholdreason,
										nextreviewdate,
										comments,
										inputdate)
								VALUES ('" . $DebtorNo . "',
										'" . $ReviewDate . "',
										'" . $_SESSION['UserID'] . "',
										'" . $Outcome . "',
										'" . $OldLimit . "',
										'" . $ResultLimit . "',
										'" . $OldHold . "',
										'" . $ResultHold . "',
										'" . $NextReviewDate . "',
										'" . $Comments . "',
										'" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The credit review could not be saved because'), '', true);

	$SQL = "UPDATE debtorsmaster SET creditlimit='" . $ResultLimit . "',
									holdreason='" . $ResultHold . "',
									nextreviewdate='" . $NextReviewDate . "'
			WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The customer account could not be updated by the credit review because'), '', true);
	DB_Txn_Commit();
	return '';
}

<?php

/* Shared helpers for credit control: reviews, holds, overdue reminders, late payment charges and write-offs.

Hold states live in holdreasons.dissallowinvoices: 0 = invoicing allowed, 1 = on hold (no new invoices),
2 = watch (staff are warned but can carry on). A customer's state is the state of its hold reason. */

// the security token that lets a user hold, release and change limits (Credit Control)
define('CREDIT_CONTROL_TOKEN', 21);

function CreditControlUser() {
	return isset($_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']) and in_array(CREDIT_CONTROL_TOKEN, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* True when the person logged in is a customer (the same test session.php uses) */
function CreditCustomerLogin() {
	global $CustomerLogin;
	return !empty($CustomerLogin);
}

/* SQL to add to a WHERE clause of a list of customers so that salespeople only see their own customers */
function CreditSalesmanCustomerSQL($DebtorField = 'debtorsmaster.debtorno') {
	if (isset($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin']) and $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] != '') {
		return " AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM custbranch
							WHERE custbranch.debtorno=" . $DebtorField . "
							AND custbranch.salesman='" . $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] . "')";
	}
	if (CreditCustomerLogin()) {
		return " AND " . $DebtorField . "='" . $_SESSION['CustomerID'] . "'";
	}
	return '';
}

/* SQL to add to a WHERE clause of a list of customer transactions so that salespeople only see their own */
function CreditSalesmanTransSQL($TransAlias = 'debtortrans') {
	if (isset($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin']) and $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] != '') {
		return " AND " . $TransAlias . ".salesperson='" . $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] . "'";
	}
	if (CreditCustomerLogin()) {
		return " AND " . $TransAlias . ".debtorno='" . $_SESSION['CustomerID'] . "'";
	}
	return '';
}

/* Can the person logged in see credit information about this customer? */
function CreditCanSeeCustomer($DebtorNo) {
	if (CreditCustomerLogin()) {
		return $DebtorNo == $_SESSION['CustomerID'];
	}
	if (isset($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin']) and $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] != '') {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM custbranch
							WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'
							AND salesman='" . $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] . "'");
		$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
		return $MyRow[0] > 0;
	}
	return true;
}

/* A date from an input of type date (Y-m-d) as an SQL date, or an empty string if it is not a real date */
function CreditSQLDate($Date) {
	if (preg_match('/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/', $Date, $Parts) and checkdate((int)$Parts[2], (int)$Parts[3], (int)$Parts[1])) {
		return $Date;
	}
	return '';
}

/* Customers can only see their own reminders and charges, not the internal reviews */
function CreditCanSeeReviews() {
	return !CreditCustomerLogin();
}

function CreditReviewOutcomes() {
	return array('kept' => __('Limit kept'),
				'raised' => __('Limit raised'),
				'lowered' => __('Limit lowered'),
				'hold' => __('Account put on hold'),
				'release' => __('Account released from hold'),
				'watch' => __('Account put on watch'));
}

function CreditReviewIntervalDays() {
	if (isset($_SESSION['CreditReviewIntervalDays']) and $_SESSION['CreditReviewIntervalDays'] > 0) {
		return (int)$_SESSION['CreditReviewIntervalDays'];
	}
	return 365;
}

/* The date, in SQL format, a customer's first review falls due when the customer is created without one */
function CreditDefaultReviewDate() {
	return date('Y-m-d', strtotime('+' . CreditReviewIntervalDays() . ' days'));
}

function CreditHoldState($Dissallow) {
	if ($Dissallow == 1) {
		return 'hold';
	} elseif ($Dissallow == 2) {
		return 'watch';
	}
	return 'ok';
}

/* The hold state of a customer, read from the database every time so no session copy can be stale.
Returns array('state' => ok|watch|hold, 'reason' => text, 'name' => customer name) or false if the customer is unknown. */
function CreditCustomerState($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT holdreasons.dissallowinvoices,
								holdreasons.reasondescription,
								debtorsmaster.name
						FROM debtorsmaster
						INNER JOIN holdreasons ON debtorsmaster.holdreason=holdreasons.reasoncode
						WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	return array('state' => CreditHoldState($MyRow['dissallowinvoices']),
				'reason' => $MyRow['reasondescription'],
				'name' => $MyRow['name']);
}

/* Gate used by every route that creates or invoices an order. Returns an empty string when the customer may be
invoiced, otherwise the reason. A customer on watch is allowed, with a warning displayed unless $Silent. */
function CreditInvoicingBlock($DebtorNo, $Silent = false) {
	$State = CreditCustomerState($DebtorNo);
	if ($State === false) {
		return '';
	}
	if ($State['state'] == 'hold') {
		return __('The account of') . ' ' . $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $State['name'] . ' ' . __('is on hold') . ' (' . $State['reason'] . ') - ' . __('no invoices can be raised for it. Please contact the credit control personnel');
	}
	if ($State['state'] == 'watch' and !$Silent) {
		prnMsg(__('The account of') . ' ' . $DebtorNo . ' - ' . $State['name'] . ' ' . __('is on watch') . ' (' . $State['reason'] . ') - ' . __('please check with the credit control personnel before extending more credit'), 'warn');
	}
	return '';
}

/* SQL boolean expression: the transaction is due, exactly as the invoice, statement, customer inquiry and aged debtors report age it */
function CreditDueSQL($TransAlias = 'debtortrans', $TermsAlias = 'paymentterms') {
	return "(CASE WHEN " . $TermsAlias . ".daysbeforedue > 0
				THEN (TO_DAYS(Now()) - TO_DAYS(" . $TransAlias . ".trandate)) >= " . $TermsAlias . ".daysbeforedue
				ELSE (TO_DAYS(Now()) - TO_DAYS(ADDDATE(last_day(" . $TransAlias . ".trandate), " . $TermsAlias . ".dayinfollowingmonth))) >= 0
			END)";
}

/* SQL boolean expression: the transaction is in an overdue band ($Days is PastDueDays1 or PastDueDays2), same rule as the reports */
function CreditOverdueBandSQL($Days, $TransAlias = 'debtortrans', $TermsAlias = 'paymentterms') {
	$Days = (int)$Days;
	return "(CASE WHEN " . $TermsAlias . ".daysbeforedue > 0
				THEN ((TO_DAYS(Now()) - TO_DAYS(" . $TransAlias . ".trandate)) > " . $TermsAlias . ".daysbeforedue
					AND (TO_DAYS(Now()) - TO_DAYS(" . $TransAlias . ".trandate)) >= (" . $TermsAlias . ".daysbeforedue + " . $Days . "))
				ELSE (TO_DAYS(Now()) - TO_DAYS(ADDDATE(last_day(" . $TransAlias . ".trandate), " . $TermsAlias . ".dayinfollowingmonth))) >= " . $Days . "
			END)";
}

/* SQL expression giving the reminder level a transaction has reached: 0 not due, 1 past due (friendly),
2 first overdue band (firm), 3 second overdue band (final notice) */
function CreditReminderLevelSQL($TransAlias = 'debtortrans', $TermsAlias = 'paymentterms') {
	return "(CASE WHEN " . CreditOverdueBandSQL($_SESSION['PastDueDays2'], $TransAlias, $TermsAlias) . " THEN 3
				WHEN " . CreditOverdueBandSQL($_SESSION['PastDueDays1'], $TransAlias, $TermsAlias) . " THEN 2
				WHEN " . CreditDueSQL($TransAlias, $TermsAlias) . " THEN 1
				ELSE 0 END)";
}

/* SQL expression for the date a transaction fell due */
function CreditDueDateSQL($TransAlias = 'debtortrans', $TermsAlias = 'paymentterms') {
	return "(CASE WHEN " . $TermsAlias . ".daysbeforedue > 0
				THEN DATE_ADD(" . $TransAlias . ".trandate, INTERVAL " . $TermsAlias . ".daysbeforedue DAY)
				ELSE ADDDATE(last_day(" . $TransAlias . ".trandate), " . $TermsAlias . ".dayinfollowingmonth)
			END)";
}

function CreditReminderLevelName($Level) {
	if ($Level == 3) {
		return __('Final notice');
	} elseif ($Level == 2) {
		return __('Firm reminder');
	}
	return __('Friendly reminder');
}

function CreditReminderText($Level) {
	$Key = 'ReminderText' . (int)$Level;
	if (isset($_SESSION[$Key]) and $_SESSION[$Key] != '') {
		return $_SESSION[$Key];
	}
	return '';
}

/* The company default accounts credit control posts to */
function CreditCompanyAccounts() {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorsact, latechargeact, baddebtact, salesexchangediffact, gllink_debtors, currencydefault
						FROM companies WHERE coycode=1");
	return DB_fetch_array($Result);
}

/* Is the account a usable ledger account (set and present in the chart)? */
function CreditAccountIsSet($AccountCode) {
	if ($AccountCode == '' or $AccountCode == '0') {
		return false;
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chartmaster WHERE accountcode='" . $AccountCode . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow[0] > 0;
}

/* Records a credit review and applies its effect on the customer in one transaction: the review row, and the new
limit, hold reason and next review date on the customer either all happen or none does (every query below rolls back and
stops the script on failure). All values are expected to be already escaped and dates in SQL format.
Returns an error message, or an empty string on success. */
function CreditSaveReview($DebtorNo, $Outcome, $NewLimit, $NewHoldReason, $ReviewDate, $NextReviewDate, $Comments) {
	if (!CreditControlUser()) {
		return __('Only credit control may record credit reviews');
	}
	$Outcomes = CreditReviewOutcomes();
	if (!isset($Outcomes[$Outcome])) {
		return __('The review outcome is not valid');
	}
	if ($NextReviewDate < $ReviewDate) {
		return __('The next review cannot be due before the date of this review');
	}

	$Result = DB_query("SELECT creditlimit, holdreason FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return __('The customer does not exist');
	}
	$Customer = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$OldLimit = $Customer['creditlimit'];
	$OldHold = $Customer['holdreason'];

	$ResultLimit = $OldLimit;
	$ResultHold = $OldHold;

	if ($Outcome == 'raised' or $Outcome == 'lowered') {
		if (!is_numeric($NewLimit) or $NewLimit < 0) {
			return __('The new credit limit must be a number that is not negative');
		}
		if ($Outcome == 'raised' and $NewLimit <= $OldLimit) {
			return __('A raised credit limit must be higher than the present limit');
		}
		if ($Outcome == 'lowered' and $NewLimit >= $OldLimit) {
			return __('A lowered credit limit must be lower than the present limit');
		}
		$ResultLimit = $NewLimit;
	}
	if ($Outcome == 'hold' or $Outcome == 'release' or $Outcome == 'watch') {
		$Wanted = array('hold' => 1, 'release' => 0, 'watch' => 2);
		$ReasonResult = DB_query("SELECT dissallowinvoices FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode='" . $NewHoldReason . "'");
		if (DB_num_rows($ReasonResult) == 0) {
			return __('The credit status chosen does not exist');
		}
		$ReasonRow = DB_fetch_row($ReasonResult);
		if ($ReasonRow[0] != $Wanted[$Outcome]) {
			return __('The credit status chosen does not match the outcome of the review');
		}
		$ResultHold = $NewHoldReason;
	}

	DB_Txn_Begin();
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditreviews (debtorno,
										reviewdate,
										userid,
										outcome,
										oldcreditlimit,
										newcreditlimit,
										oldholdreason,
										newholdreason,
										nextreviewdate,
										comments,
										inputdate)
								VALUES ('" . $DebtorNo . "',
										'" . $ReviewDate . "',
										'" . $_SESSION['UserID'] . "',
										'" . $Outcome . "',
										'" . $OldLimit . "',
										'" . $ResultLimit . "',
										'" . $OldHold . "',
										'" . $ResultHold . "',
										'" . $NextReviewDate . "',
										'" . $Comments . "',
										'" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The credit review could not be saved because'), '', true);

	$SQL = "UPDATE debtorsmaster SET creditlimit='" . $ResultLimit . "',
									holdreason='" . $ResultHold . "',
									nextreviewdate='" . $NextReviewDate . "'
			WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The customer account could not be updated by the credit review because'), '', true);
	DB_Txn_Commit();
	return '';
}

content.content:
1	# webERP order delivery details, freight costs, payment terms and main menu (DeliveryDetails.php, FreightCosts.php, PaymentTerms.php, index.php)
2	
3	Part of [webERP: sales, purchasing, stock, manufacturing, master data, reporting, API…](weberp-sales-purchasing-stock-manufacturing-master-data-repo-151/brief.md) (path from the export's root): its brief says how work moves through the area and what repairs a failed step.
4	
5	Four pages. `webERP/DeliveryDetails.php` validates delivery and freight details for a cart, then saves or updates the sales order or quotation. `webERP/FreightCosts.php` maintains the `freightcosts` rates. `webERP/PaymentTerms.php` maintains the `paymentterms` definitions. `webERP/index.php` renders the main menu. DeliveryDetails.php takes the cart from `webERP/SelectOrderItems.php` and hands off to `webERP/RecurringSalesOrders.php` and `webERP/SelectOrderItems.php`.
6	
7	## Contract
8	
9	**DeliveryDetails.php**
10	- It is reached by a meta-refresh redirect from `webERP/SelectOrderItems.php`. That redirect fires when `$_POST['DeliveryDetails']` is set, and goes to `DeliveryDetails.php?identifier=...`.
11	- It reads `$_GET['identifier']` and the cart `$_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]`.
12	- It reads these POST fields:
13	  - DeliverTo, BrAdd1-6, FreightCost, ShipVia, DeliverBlind
14	  - DeliveryDate, QuoteDate, ConfirmedDate
15	  - PhoneNo, Email, Location, SpecialInstructions, DeliveryDays
16	  - Comments, CustRef, Quotation (0 or 1), SalesPerson
17	  - ReprintPackingSlip
18	  - Buttons: Update, BackToLineDetails, MakeRecurringOrder, ProcessOrder
19	- It writes `salesorders` and `salesorderdetails`. Quotation numbers and order numbers both come from `GetNextTransNo(30)`.
20	- On new orders with automatic work orders it also writes `workorders`, `woitems`, `woserialnos`, and `stockmaster.nextserialno`.
21	- On converting a contract quotation it writes `contracts`, `bom`, `workorders`, and `woitems`.
22	- It calls `CalcFreightCost(total, BrAdd2..BrAdd6, totalVolume, totalWeight, Location, DefaultCurrency)`, which returns (FreightCost, BestShipper). (Behaviour not in this topic.)
23	- It calls `WoRealRequirements(WONo, location, stockid or contractref)` (behaviour not in this topic).
24	- It calls `SendEmailFromWebERP($SysAdminEmail, $_SESSION['FactoryManagerEmail'], subject, body, '', false)`. The body is "A new work order has been created for:\n" followed by `StockID - ItemDescription x WOQuantity Units`, then order and customer details, and reserved serial numbers if the item is serialised.
25	- It calls `CalcEarliestDispatchDate()` (behaviour not in this topic).
26	- It forwards to `RecurringSalesOrders.php` with identifier and `NewRecurringOrder=Yes`, or to `SelectOrderItems.php` with identifier.
27	- On completion it outputs links to these pages:
28	  - `PrintCustOrder.php?identifier&TransNo=$OrderNo`
29	  - `PrintCustOrder_generic.php?identifier&TransNo=$OrderNo`
30	  - `ConfirmDispatch_Invoice.php?identifier&OrderNumber=$OrderNo`
31	  - `PDFQuotation.php?identifier&QuotationNo=$OrderNo&orientation=landscape` and `orientation=portrait`
32	  - `SelectOrderItems.php?identifier&NewOrder=Yes`
33	
34	**FreightCosts.php**
35	- It reads GET/POST `LocationFrom`, `ShipperID` and `SelectedFreightCost`.
36	- It reads POST `DestinationCountry`, `Destination`, `CubRate`, `KGRate`, `MAXKGs`, `MAXCub`, `FixedPrice`, `MinimumChg`. The numeric ones default to 0 if empty.
37	- It writes the `freightcosts` table. Columns:
38	  - `shipcostfromid` int PK auto-increment
39	  - `locationfrom` varchar(5), FK to `locations.loccode`
40	  - `destinationcountry` varchar(40)
41	  - `destination` varchar(40) default ''
42	  - `shipperid` int, FK to `shippers.shipper_id`
43	  - `cubrate`, `kgrate`, `fixedprice`, `minimumchg`: double default 0
44	  - `maxkgs`, `maxcub`: double default 999999
45	- It reads the `shippers` and `locations` tables. The location list is joined to `locationusers` for `userid=$_SESSION['UserID']` and `canupd=1`.
46	- It is linked from the `menuitems.sql` system "Reports" group, from `SecurityTokens.php` and from `scripts.sql` (not read).
47	
48	**PaymentTerms.php**
49	- It reads GET/POST `SelectedTerms`, and POST `TermsIndicator`, `Terms`, `DayNumber` and `DaysOrFoll`.
50	- It writes `paymentterms` (`termsindicator` char(2) PK, `terms` char(40), `daysbeforedue` smallint default 0, `dayinfollowingmonth` smallint default 0).
51	- It reads COUNT(*) from `debtorsmaster` and `suppliers` by `paymentterms`.
52	- It is linked from the same `menuitems.sql` group.
53	
54	**index.php**
55	- It reads POST `NewLogin` and `CompanyNameField`, GET `Application` and COOKIE `Module`.
56	- It reads session keys `UserID`, `FirstLogIn`, `DatabaseName`, `Module`, `ModulesEnabled`, `PageSecurityArray`, `AllowedPageSecurityTokens`, `Theme` and `CustomerID`.
57	- It queries `session_data` for the user's module value and calls `GetRptLinks($_SESSION['Module'])`.
58	- It sets a Company cookie and redirects to `InitialScripts.php`.
59	
60	## Entry points
61	
62	**DeliveryDetails.php, in order**
63	1. `if $_GET['identifier'] not set` -> error "This page can only be read if an order has been entered", footer, exit.
64	2. `if !isset($_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]) OR !isset(...->DebtorNo)` -> the same error, exit.
65	3. `if ItemsOrdered == 0` -> error "...if an there are items on the order", exit.
66	4. `if isset($_POST['ProcessOrder']) OR isset($_POST['MakeRecurringOrder'])` -> set `$_POST['Update']='Yes rerun the validation checks'` and store `OldFreightCost`.
67	5. `if isset($_POST['Update']) OR isset($_POST['BackToLineDetails']) OR isset($_POST['MakeRecurringOrder'])` -> run the validation block.
68	6. `if isset($_POST['MakeRecurringOrder']) AND $_POST['Quotation']==1` -> error "A recurring order cannot be made from a quotation" (the message is in RecurringSalesOrders.php).
69	7. `if InputErrors==0` -> run freight calculation and the branch lookup.
70	8. `if isset($_POST['MakeRecurringOrder']) AND !$InputErrors` -> forward to `RecurringSalesOrders.php` with `NewRecurringOrder=Yes`, exit.
71	9. `if BackToLineDetails == __('Modify Order Lines')` -> forward to `SelectOrderItems.php`, exit.
72	10. `if isset($_POST['ProcessOrder'])` -> check whether to process (see Decisions).
73	11. `if isset($OK_to_PROCESS) AND $OK_to_PROCESS==1 AND $_SESSION['ExistingOrder'.$identifier]==0` -> insert a new order.
74	12. `if isset($OK_to_PROCESS) AND $OK_to_PROCESS==1 AND ExistingOrder!=0` -> update the existing order.
75	13. No permission check is shown.
76	
77	**FreightCosts.php**
78	- `if !isset($LocationFrom) OR !isset($ShipperID)` -> show the selection form.

# webERP order delivery details, freight costs, payment terms and main menu (DeliveryDetails.php, FreightCosts.php, PaymentTerms.php, index.php)

Part of [webERP: sales, purchasing, stock, manufacturing, master data, reporting, API…](weberp-sales-purchasing-stock-manufacturing-master-data-repo-151/brief.md) (path from the export's root): its brief says how work moves through the area and what repairs a failed step.

Four pages. `webERP/DeliveryDetails.php` validates delivery and freight details for a cart, then saves or updates the sales order or quotation. `webERP/FreightCosts.php` maintains the `freightcosts` rates. `webERP/PaymentTerms.php` maintains the `paymentterms` definitions. `webERP/index.php` renders the main menu. DeliveryDetails.php takes the cart from `webERP/SelectOrderItems.php` and hands off to `webERP/RecurringSalesOrders.php` and `webERP/SelectOrderItems.php`.

## Contract

**DeliveryDetails.php**
- It is reached by a meta-refresh redirect from `webERP/SelectOrderItems.php`. That redirect fires when `$_POST['DeliveryDetails']` is set, and goes to `DeliveryDetails.php?identifier=...`.
- It reads `$_GET['identifier']` and the cart `$_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]`.
- It reads these POST fields:
  - DeliverTo, BrAdd1-6, FreightCost, ShipVia, DeliverBlind
  - DeliveryDate, QuoteDate, ConfirmedDate
  - PhoneNo, Email, Location, SpecialInstructions, DeliveryDays
  - Comments, CustRef, Quotation (0 or 1), SalesPerson
  - ReprintPackingSlip
  - Buttons: Update, BackToLineDetails, MakeRecurringOrder, ProcessOrder
- It writes `salesorders` and `salesorderdetails`. Quotation numbers and order numbers both come from `GetNextTransNo(30)`.
- On new orders with automatic work orders it also writes `workorders`, `woitems`, `woserialnos`, and `stockmaster.nextserialno`.
- On converting a contract quotation it writes `contracts`, `bom`, `workorders`, and `woitems`.
- It calls `CalcFreightCost(total, BrAdd2..BrAdd6, totalVolume, totalWeight, Location, DefaultCurrency)`, which returns (FreightCost, BestShipper). (Behaviour not in this topic.)
- It calls `WoRealRequirements(WONo, location, stockid or contractref)` (behaviour not in this topic).
- It calls `SendEmailFromWebERP($SysAdminEmail, $_SESSION['FactoryManagerEmail'], subject, body, '', false)`. The body is "A new work order has been created for:\n" followed by `StockID - ItemDescription x WOQuantity Units`, then order and customer details, and reserved serial numbers if the item is serialised.
- It calls `CalcEarliestDispatchDate()` (behaviour not in this topic).
- It forwards to `RecurringSalesOrders.php` with identifier and `NewRecurringOrder=Yes`, or to `SelectOrderItems.php` with identifier.
- On completion it outputs links to these pages:
  - `PrintCustOrder.php?identifier&TransNo=$OrderNo`
  - `PrintCustOrder_generic.php?identifier&TransNo=$OrderNo`
  - `ConfirmDispatch_Invoice.php?identifier&OrderNumber=$OrderNo`
  - `PDFQuotation.php?identifier&QuotationNo=$OrderNo&orientation=landscape` and `orientation=portrait`
  - `SelectOrderItems.php?identifier&NewOrder=Yes`

**FreightCosts.php**
- It reads GET/POST `LocationFrom`, `ShipperID` and `SelectedFreightCost`.
- It reads POST `DestinationCountry`, `Destination`, `CubRate`, `KGRate`, `MAXKGs`, `MAXCub`, `FixedPrice`, `MinimumChg`. The numeric ones default to 0 if empty.
- It writes the `freightcosts` table. Columns:
  - `shipcostfromid` int PK auto-increment
  - `locationfrom` varchar(5), FK to `locations.loccode`
  - `destinationcountry` varchar(40)
  - `destination` varchar(40) default ''
  - `shipperid` int, FK to `shippers.shipper_id`
  - `cubrate`, `kgrate`, `fixedprice`, `minimumchg`: double default 0
  - `maxkgs`, `maxcub`: double default 999999
- It reads the `shippers` and `locations` tables. The location list is joined to `locationusers` for `userid=$_SESSION['UserID']` and `canupd=1`.
- It is linked from the `menuitems.sql` system "Reports" group, from `SecurityTokens.php` and from `scripts.sql` (not read).

**PaymentTerms.php**
- It reads GET/POST `SelectedTerms`, and POST `TermsIndicator`, `Terms`, `DayNumber` and `DaysOrFoll`.
- It writes `paymentterms` (`termsindicator` char(2) PK, `terms` char(40), `daysbeforedue` smallint default 0, `dayinfollowingmonth` smallint default 0).
- It reads COUNT(*) from `debtorsmaster` and `suppliers` by `paymentterms`.
- It is linked from the same `menuitems.sql` group.

**index.php**
- It reads POST `NewLogin` and `CompanyNameField`, GET `Application` and COOKIE `Module`.
- It reads session keys `UserID`, `FirstLogIn`, `DatabaseName`, `Module`, `ModulesEnabled`, `PageSecurityArray`, `AllowedPageSecurityTokens`, `Theme` and `CustomerID`.
- It queries `session_data` for the user's module value and calls `GetRptLinks($_SESSION['Module'])`.
- It sets a Company cookie and redirects to `InitialScripts.php`.

## Entry points

**DeliveryDetails.php, in order**
1. `if $_GET['identifier'] not set` -> error "This page can only be read if an order has been entered", footer, exit.
2. `if !isset($_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]) OR !isset(...->DebtorNo)` -> the same error, exit.
3. `if ItemsOrdered == 0` -> error "...if an there are items on the order", exit.
4. `if isset($_POST['ProcessOrder']) OR isset($_POST['MakeRecurringOrder'])` -> set `$_POST['Update']='Yes rerun the validation checks'` and store `OldFreightCost`.
5. `if isset($_POST['Update']) OR isset($_POST['BackToLineDetails']) OR isset($_POST['MakeRecurringOrder'])` -> run the validation block.
6. `if isset($_POST['MakeRecurringOrder']) AND $_POST['Quotation']==1` -> error "A recurring order cannot be made from a quotation" (the message is in RecurringSalesOrders.php).
7. `if InputErrors==0` -> run freight calculation and the branch lookup.
8. `if isset($_POST['MakeRecurringOrder']) AND !$InputErrors` -> forward to `RecurringSalesOrders.php` with `NewRecurringOrder=Yes`, exit.
9. `if BackToLineDetails == __('Modify Order Lines')` -> forward to `SelectOrderItems.php`, exit.
10. `if isset($_POST['ProcessOrder'])` -> check whether to process (see Decisions).
11. `if isset($OK_to_PROCESS) AND $OK_to_PROCESS==1 AND $_SESSION['ExistingOrder'.$identifier]==0` -> insert a new order.
12. `if isset($OK_to_PROCESS) AND $OK_to_PROCESS==1 AND ExistingOrder!=0` -> update the existing order.
13. No permission check is shown.

**FreightCosts.php**
- `if !isset($LocationFrom) OR !isset($ShipperID)` -> show the selection form.
- `if isset($_POST['submit'])` -> validate, then INSERT or UPDATE.
- `if isset($_GET['delete'])` -> DELETE.

1	# webERP recurring sales orders: template maintenance, due-order processing, and the sales integrity check
2	
3	Part of [webERP: sales, purchasing, stock, manufacturing, master data, reporting, API…](weberp-sales-purchasing-stock-manufacturing-master-data-repo-151/brief.md) (path from the export's root): its brief says how work moves through the area and what repairs a failed step.
4	
5	Three files make up this topic:
6	- `webERP/RecurringSalesOrders.php` creates, updates and deletes recurring order templates.
7	- `webERP/RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php` is a cron or URL job. It turns due templates into sales orders and, optionally, invoices.
8	- `webERP/Z_SalesIntegrityCheck.php` is a read-only report on mismatched sales records.
9	
10	The template page takes its starting data from the order entry screen's session cart. The process job writes `salesorders`, `salesorderdetails`, `stockmoves`, `gltrans`, `debtortrans` and related tables.
11	
12	## Contract
13	
14	### RecurringSalesOrders.php
15	
16	**Input**
17	- `$_GET['identifier']` is the session cart key, `Items<identifier>`. It defaults to `date('U')`.
18	- `$_GET['NewRecurringOrder']` or `$_POST['NewRecurringOrder']` sets `$NewRecurringOrder` to 'Yes', otherwise 'No'.
19	- `$_GET['ModifyRecurringSalesOrder']` carries a `recurrorderno`.
20	- `$_POST['ExistingRecurrOrderNo']`, `$_POST['DeleteRecurringOrder']`, `$_POST['Process']`, `$_POST['StartDate']`, `$_POST['StopDate']`, `$_POST['Quotation']` and `$_POST['MakeRecurringOrder']` come from the form.
21	- `$_POST['Frequency']` takes one of 52, 26, 12, 6, 4, 2, 1. The labels are Weekly, Fortnightly, Monthly, Bi-monthly, Quarterly, Bi-Annually, Annually.
22	- `$_POST['AutoInvoice']` is 0 or 1.
23	
24	**Who sends to it (live callers)**
25	- `source/webERP/DeliveryDetails.php:276` redirects to `RecurringSalesOrders.php?identifier=<id>&NewRecurringOrder=Yes`.
26	- `source/webERP/SelectRecurringSalesOrder.php:98` links to `RecurringSalesOrders.php?ModifyRecurringSalesOrder=<recurrorderno>`.
27	
28	**Writes**
29	- `recurringsalesorders` header: debtorno, branchcode, customerref, comments, orddate (current date), ordertype, deliverto, deladd1-6, contactphone, contactemail, freightcost, fromstkloc, shipvia, lastrecurrence (from StartDate), stopdate (from StopDate), frequency, autoinvoice.
30	- `recurrsalesorderdetails` lines: recurrorderno, stkcode, unitprice, quantity, discountpercent, narrative.
31	
32	**Table definitions**
33	- `recurringsalesorders`: PK `recurrorderno` auto-increment. Foreign key (branchcode, debtorno) -> `custbranch`.
34	  - `frequency` is tinyint, default 1.
35	  - `autoinvoice` is tinyint, default 0.
36	  - `lastrecurrence` and `stopdate` are date columns.
37	  - `contactemail` is varchar(25).
38	  - `contactphone` is varchar(25).
39	  - `comments` is longblob.
40	- `recurrsalesorderdetails`: recurrorderno is a foreign key to `recurringsalesorders`. stkcode is a foreign key to `stockmaster.stockid`. unitprice, quantity and discountpercent are doubles. narrative is text.
41	
42	### RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php
43	
44	**Input**
45	- `$_GET['Database']` or `$argv[1]` sets `$_SESSION['DatabaseName']`, `$DatabaseName` and `$_POST['CompanyNameField']`.
46	- Cron form: `php -f RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php "weberpdemo"`. URL form: `?Database=weberpdemo`.
47	- The menu (`install/sql/data/menuitems.sql`) lists it as "Process Recurring Orders" under Sales > Transactions.
48	- `$_SESSION['UserID']` is used in the location filter.
49	
50	**Output**
51	- `salesorders`, `salesorderdetails`, `recurringsalesorders.lastrecurrence`.
52	- When `autoinvoice == 1`: `stockmoves` (type 10), `stockmovestaxes`, `salesanalysis`, `gltrans` (type 10), `debtortrans` (type 10), `debtortranstaxes`.
53	- An update to `salesorders.comments` appending ' Inv <InvoiceNo>'.
54	- An email advice.
55	
56	### Z_SalesIntegrityCheck.php
57	It is requested as a page and runs read-only SELECTs on `debtortrans`, `salesorders`, `debtortranstaxes`, `gltrans`, `salesorderdetails` and `stockmoves`.
58	
59	## Entry points and guards
60	
61	### RecurringSalesOrders.php
62	1. `if isset($_GET['NewRecurringOrder']) or isset($_POST['NewRecurringOrder'])` -> `$NewRecurringOrder='Yes'`, else 'No'.

# webERP recurring sales orders: template maintenance, due-order processing, and the sales integrity check

Part of [webERP: sales, purchasing, stock, manufacturing, master data, reporting, API…](weberp-sales-purchasing-stock-manufacturing-master-data-repo-151/brief.md) (path from the export's root): its brief says how work moves through the area and what repairs a failed step.

Three files make up this topic:
- `webERP/RecurringSalesOrders.php` creates, updates and deletes recurring order templates.
- `webERP/RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php` is a cron or URL job. It turns due templates into sales orders and, optionally, invoices.
- `webERP/Z_SalesIntegrityCheck.php` is a read-only report on mismatched sales records.

The template page takes its starting data from the order entry screen's session cart. The process job writes `salesorders`, `salesorderdetails`, `stockmoves`, `gltrans`, `debtortrans` and related tables.

## Contract

### RecurringSalesOrders.php

**Input**
- `$_GET['identifier']` is the session cart key, `Items<identifier>`. It defaults to `date('U')`.
- `$_GET['NewRecurringOrder']` or `$_POST['NewRecurringOrder']` sets `$NewRecurringOrder` to 'Yes', otherwise 'No'.
- `$_GET['ModifyRecurringSalesOrder']` carries a `recurrorderno`.
- `$_POST['ExistingRecurrOrderNo']`, `$_POST['DeleteRecurringOrder']`, `$_POST['Process']`, `$_POST['StartDate']`, `$_POST['StopDate']`, `$_POST['Quotation']` and `$_POST['MakeRecurringOrder']` come from the form.
- `$_POST['Frequency']` takes one of 52, 26, 12, 6, 4, 2, 1. The labels are Weekly, Fortnightly, Monthly, Bi-monthly, Quarterly, Bi-Annually, Annually.
- `$_POST['AutoInvoice']` is 0 or 1.

**Who sends to it (live callers)**
- `source/webERP/DeliveryDetails.php:276` redirects to `RecurringSalesOrders.php?identifier=<id>&NewRecurringOrder=Yes`.
- `source/webERP/SelectRecurringSalesOrder.php:98` links to `RecurringSalesOrders.php?ModifyRecurringSalesOrder=<recurrorderno>`.

**Writes**
- `recurringsalesorders` header: debtorno, branchcode, customerref, comments, orddate (current date), ordertype, deliverto, deladd1-6, contactphone, contactemail, freightcost, fromstkloc, shipvia, lastrecurrence (from StartDate), stopdate (from StopDate), frequency, autoinvoice.
- `recurrsalesorderdetails` lines: recurrorderno, stkcode, unitprice, quantity, discountpercent, narrative.

**Table definitions**
- `recurringsalesorders`: PK `recurrorderno` auto-increment. Foreign key (branchcode, debtorno) -> `custbranch`.
  - `frequency` is tinyint, default 1.
  - `autoinvoice` is tinyint, default 0.
  - `lastrecurrence` and `stopdate` are date columns.
  - `contactemail` is varchar(25).
  - `contactphone` is varchar(25).
  - `comments` is longblob.
- `recurrsalesorderdetails`: recurrorderno is a foreign key to `recurringsalesorders`. stkcode is a foreign key to `stockmaster.stockid`. unitprice, quantity and discountpercent are doubles. narrative is text.

### RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php

**Input**
- `$_GET['Database']` or `$argv[1]` sets `$_SESSION['DatabaseName']`, `$DatabaseName` and `$_POST['CompanyNameField']`.
- Cron form: `php -f RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php "weberpdemo"`. URL form: `?Database=weberpdemo`.
- The menu (`install/sql/data/menuitems.sql`) lists it as "Process Recurring Orders" under Sales > Transactions.
- `$_SESSION['UserID']` is used in the location filter.

**Output**
- `salesorders`, `salesorderdetails`, `recurringsalesorders.lastrecurrence`.
- When `autoinvoice == 1`: `stockmoves` (type 10), `stockmovestaxes`, `salesanalysis`, `gltrans` (type 10), `debtortrans` (type 10), `debtortranstaxes`.
- An update to `salesorders.comments` appending ' Inv <InvoiceNo>'.
- An email advice.

### Z_SalesIntegrityCheck.php
It is requested as a page and runs read-only SELECTs on `debtortrans`, `salesorders`, `debtortranstaxes`, `gltrans`, `salesorderdetails` and `stockmoves`.

## Entry points and guards

### RecurringSalesOrders.php
1. `if isset($_GET['NewRecurringOrder']) or isset($_POST['NewRecurringOrder'])` -> `$NewRecurringOrder='Yes'`, else 'No'.
2. `if isset($_GET['ModifyRecurringSalesOrder'])` -> load the template into the Cart. It selects `recurringsalesorders` joined to `debtorsmaster` and `salestypes`, and lines from `recurrsalesorderdetails` joined to `stockmaster` and `locstock`. Each line is added with `Cart::add_to_cart()`.
   - `else if !isset($_POST['NewRecurringOrder'])` -> error, exit.
3. `if (!isset($_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]) OR ItemsOrdered == 0) AND $NewRecurringOrder == 'Yes'` -> error "A new recurring order can only be created if an order template has already been created from the normal order entry screen", exit.
4. `if isset($_POST['DeleteRecurringOrder'])` -> DELETE `recurrsalesorderdetails` WHERE recurrorderno, then DELETE `recurringsalesorders` WHERE recurrorderno. Message "Successfully deleted", unset Items, exit.
5. `if isset($_POST['Process'])` -> validation, in order. Each failure sets `$InputErrors=1`:
   - `if !Is_Date(StartDate)` -> error.
   - `if !Is_Date(StopDate)` -> error.
   - `if Date1GreaterThanDate2(StartDate, StopDate)` -> "end date ... must be after the start date".
   - `if isset($_POST['MakeRecurringOrder']) AND $_POST['Quotation']==1` -> "A recurring order cannot be made from a quotation".
   - `if $InputErrors == 0` -> save. Otherwise no database work and the form is shown again.

No permission check is shown on modify, delete or save.

### RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php
There is no authentication guard of its own; `session.php` is included.
- `if isset($_GET['Database'])` -> set the database name. `if isset($argv[1])` -> set the database name. The name is not validated, and the file carries @todo comments about a whitelist.
- Due selection query:
  - Tables: `recurringsalesorders` INNER JOIN `locationusers` (loccode = fromstkloc, userid = `$_SESSION['UserID']`, canupd=1), `debtorsmaster`, `custbranch`, `salestypes`, `locations`.

// InsertSalesOrderHeader and ModifySalesOrderHeader have date fields

/** Check that the custmerref field is 50 characters or less long */
function VerifyCustomerRef($customerref, $i, $Errors) {
	if (mb_strlen($customerref)>50) {
		$Errors[$i] = InvalidCustomerRef;
	}
	return $Errors;
}

/** Check that the buyername field is 50 characters or less long */
function VerifyBuyerName($buyername, $i, $Errors) {
	if (mb_strlen($buyername)>50) {
		$Errors[$i] = InvalidBuyerName;
	}
	return $Errors;
}

/** Check that the comments field is 256 characters or less long */
function VerifyComments($comments, $i, $Errors) {
	if (mb_strlen($comments)>256) {
		$Errors[$i] = InvalidComments;
	}
	return $Errors;
}

/** Check that the order date is a valid date. The date
 * must be in the same format as the date format specified in the
 * target webERP company */
function VerifyOrderDate($orddate, $i, $Errors) {
	$SQL="SELECT confvalue FROM config WHERE confname='DefaultDateFormat'";
	$Result=api_DB_query($SQL);
	$MyRow=DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$DateFormat=$MyRow[0];
	if (mb_strstr($orddate,"/")) {
		$DateArray = explode('/',$orddate);
	} elseif (mb_strstr($orddate,".")) {
		$DateArray = explode('.',$orddate);
	}
	if ($DateFormat=='d/m/Y') {
		$Day=$DateArray[0];
		$Month=$DateArray[1];
		$Year=$DateArray[2];
	} elseif ($DateFormat=='m/d/Y') {
		$Day=$DateArray[1];
		$Month=$DateArray[0];
		$Year=$DateArray[2];
	} elseif ($DateFormat=='Y/m/d') {
		$Day=$DateArray[2];
		$Month=$DateArray[1];
		$Year=$DateArray[0];
	} elseif ($DateFormat=='d.m.Y') {
		$Day=$DateArray[0];
		$Month=$DateArray[1];
		$Year=$DateArray[2];
	}
	if (!checkdate(intval($Month), intval($Day), intval($Year))) {
		$Errors[$i] = InvalidOrderDate;
	}
	return $Errors;
}

/** Check that the order type is set up in the weberp database */
function VerifyOrderType($Ordertype, $i, $Errors) {
	$Searchsql = "SELECT COUNT(typeabbrev)
				 FROM salestypes
				 WHERE typeabbrev='" . $Ordertype."'";
	$SearchResult=api_DB_query($Searchsql);
	$Answer = DB_fetch_row($SearchResult);
	if ($Answer[0] == 0) {
		$Errors[$i] = SalesTypeNotSetup;
	}
	return $Errors;
}

function InvoiceSalesOrder($OrderNo, $User, $Password) {

	$Errors = array();
	$db = db($User, $Password);
	if (gettype($db)=='integer') {
		$Errors[]=NoAuthorisation;
		return $Errors;
	}
	$Errors=VerifyOrderHeaderExists($OrderNo, sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	if (sizeof($Errors)!=0) {
		return $Errors;
	}
	/*Does not deal with assembly items or serialise/lot track items - for use by POS */
	/*Get Company Defaults */
	$ReadCoyResult = api_DB_query("SELECT debtorsact,
											freightact,
											gllink_debtors,
											gllink_stock
									FROM companies
									WHERE coycode=1");

	$CompanyRecord = DB_fetch_array($ReadCoyResult);
	if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
		$Errors[] = NoCompanyRecord;
	}

	$OrderHeaderSQL = "SELECT salesorders.debtorno,
							  debtorsmaster.name,
							  salesorders.branchcode,
							  salesorders.customerref,
							  salesorders.orddate,
							  salesorders.ordertype,
							  salesorders.shipvia,
							  custbranch.area,
							  custbranch.taxgroupid,
							  debtorsmaster.currcode,
							  currencies.rate,
							  salesorders.fromstkloc,
							  custbranch.salesman
						FROM salesorders
						INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
						ON salesorders.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
						INNER JOIN custbranch
						ON salesorders.debtorno = custbranch.debtorno
						AND salesorders.branchcode = custbranch.branchcode
						INNER JOIN locations
						ON locations.loccode=salesorders.fromstkloc
						INNER JOIN currencies
						ON debtorsmaster.currcode=currencies.currabrev
						WHERE salesorders.orderno = '" . $OrderNo . "'";

	$OrderHeaderResult = api_DB_query($OrderHeaderSQL);
	if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
		$Errors[] = NoReadOrder;
	}

	$OrderHeader = DB_fetch_array($OrderHeaderResult);

	$TaxProvResult = api_DB_query("SELECT taxprovinceid FROM locations WHERE loccode='" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] ."'");
	if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
		$Errors[] = NoTaxProvince;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($TaxProvResult);
	$DispTaxProvinceID = $MyRow[0];

	$LineItemsSQL = "SELECT stkcode,
							unitprice,
							quantity,
							discountpercent,
							taxcatid,
							mbflag,
							actualcost AS standardcost
					FROM salesorderdetails INNER JOIN stockmaster
					ON salesorderdetails.stkcode = stockmaster.stockid
					WHERE orderno ='" . $OrderNo . "'
					AND completed=0";

	$LineItemsResult = api_DB_query($LineItemsSQL);
	if (DB_error_no() != 0 OR DB_num_rows($LineItemsResult)==0) {
		$Errors[] = NoReadOrderLines;
		return $Errors;
	}

/*Start an SQL transaction */
	DB_Txn_Begin();
/*Now Get the next invoice number - function in SQL_CommonFunctions */
	$InvoiceNo = GetNextTransNo(10);
	$PeriodNo = GetCurrentPeriod();

	$TaxTotals =array();

	$TotalFXNetInvoice = 0;
	$TotalFXTax = 0;
	$LineCounter =0;
	$LineTaxes = array();

	while ($OrderLineRow = DB_fetch_array($LineItemsResult)) {

		$StandardCost = $OrderLineRow['standardcost'];
		$LocalCurrencyPrice= ($OrderLineRow['unitprice'] *(1- floatval($OrderLineRow['discountpercent'])))/ $OrderHeader['rate'];
		$LineNetAmount = $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] *(1- floatval($OrderLineRow['discountpercent']));

		/*Gets the Taxes and rates applicable to this line from the TaxGroup of the branch and TaxCategory of the item
		and the taxprovince of the dispatch location */

		$SQL = "SELECT taxgrouptaxes.calculationorder,
						taxauthorities.description,
						taxgrouptaxes.taxauthid,
						taxauthorities.taxglcode,
						taxgrouptaxes.taxontax,
						taxauthrates.taxrate
				FROM taxauthrates INNER JOIN taxgrouptaxes ON
					taxauthrates.taxauthority=taxgrouptaxes.taxauthid
					INNER JOIN taxauthorities ON
					taxauthrates.taxauthority=taxauthorities.taxid
				WHERE taxgrouptaxes.taxgroupid='" . $OrderHeader['taxgroupid'] . "'
				AND taxauthrates.dispatchtaxprovince='" . $DispTaxProvinceID . "'
				AND taxauthrates.taxcatid = '" . $OrderLineRow['taxcatid'] . "'
				ORDER BY taxgrouptaxes.calculationorder";

		$GetTaxRatesResult = api_DB_query($SQL);

		if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
			$Errors[] = TaxRatesFailed;
		}
		$LineTaxAmount = 0;
		$TaxAuthAmount = 0;
		while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($GetTaxRatesResult)){

			if (!isset($TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['FXAmount'])) {
				$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['FXAmount']=0;
			}
			$TaxAuthID=$MyRow['taxauthid'];
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['GLCode'] = $MyRow['taxglcode'];
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['TaxRate'] = $MyRow['taxrate'];
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['TaxAuthDescription'] = $MyRow['description'];

			if ($MyRow['taxontax'] ==1){
				$TaxAuthAmount = ($LineNetAmount+$LineTaxAmount) * $MyRow['taxrate'];
			} else {
				$TaxAuthAmount =  $LineNetAmount * $MyRow['taxrate'];
			}
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['FXAmount'] += $TaxAuthAmount;

			/*Make an array of the taxes and amounts including GLcodes for later posting - need debtortransid
			so can only post once the debtor trans is posted - can only post debtor trans when all tax is calculated */
			$LineTaxes[$LineCounter][$MyRow['calculationorder']] = array('TaxCalculationOrder' =>$MyRow['calculationorder'],
											'TaxAuthID' =>$MyRow['taxauthid'],
											'TaxAuthDescription'=>$MyRow['description'],
											'TaxRate'=>$MyRow['taxrate'],
											'TaxOnTax'=>$MyRow['taxontax'],
											'TaxAuthAmount'=>$TaxAuthAmount);
			$LineTaxAmount += $TaxAuthAmount;

		}//end loop around Taxes

		$TotalFXNetInvoice += $LineNetAmount;
		$TotalFXTax += $LineTaxAmount;

		/*Now update SalesOrderDetails for the quantity invoiced and the actual dispatch dates. */
		$SQL = "UPDATE salesorderdetails
				SET qtyinvoiced = qtyinvoiced + " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . ",
					actualdispatchdate = '" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] .  "',
					completed='1'
				WHERE orderno = '" . $OrderNo . "'
				AND stkcode = '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'";

		$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);


		if ($OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='B' OR $OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='M') {
			$Assembly = false;

			/* Need to get the current location quantity
			will need it later for the stock movement */
			$SQL="SELECT locstock.quantity
					FROM locstock
					WHERE locstock.stockid='" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
					AND loccode= '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "'";
			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);

			if (DB_num_rows($Result)==1){
				$LocQtyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
				$QtyOnHandPrior = $LocQtyRow[0];
			} else {
				/* There must be some error this should never happen */
				$QtyOnHandPrior = 0;
			}

			$SQL = "UPDATE locstock
					SET quantity = locstock.quantity - " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "
					WHERE locstock.stockid = '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
					AND loccode = '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "'";
			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmoves (stockid,
											type,
											transno,
											loccode,
											trandate,
											debtorno,
											branchcode,
											price,
											prd,
											reference,
											qty,
											discountpercent,
											standardcost,
											newqoh)
					VALUES ('" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "',
							'10',
							'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
							'" . $LocalCurrencyPrice . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $OrderNo . "',
							'" . -$OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
							'" . $OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] . "',
							'" . $StandardCost . "',
							'" . ($QtyOnHandPrior - $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "' )";

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

		} elseif ($OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='A'){ /* its an assembly */
			/*Need to get the BOM for this part and make
			stock moves for the components then update the Location stock balances */
			$Assembly=true;
			$StandardCost =0; /*To start with - accumulate the cost of the comoponents for use in journals later on */
			$SQL = "SELECT bom.component,
							bom.quantity,
							stockmaster.actualcost AS standard
						FROM bom INNER JOIN stockmaster
						ON bom.component=stockmaster.stockid
						WHERE bom.parent='" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
						AND bom.effectiveafter <= CURRENT_DATE
						AND bom.effectiveto > CURRENT_DATE";

			$AssResult = api_DB_query($SQL);

			while ($AssParts = DB_fetch_array($AssResult)){

				$StandardCost += ($AssParts['standard'] * $AssParts['quantity']) ;
				/* Need to get the current location quantity
				will need it later for the stock movement */
				$SQL="SELECT locstock.quantity
						FROM locstock
						WHERE locstock.stockid='" . $AssParts['component'] . "'
						AND loccode= '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "'";

				$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);
				if (DB_num_rows($Result)==1){
					$LocQtyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
					$QtyOnHandPrior = $LocQtyRow[0];
				} else {
					/*There must be some error this should never happen */
					$QtyOnHandPrior = 0;
				}
				if (empty($AssParts['standard'])) {
					$AssParts['standard']=0;
				}
				$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmoves (stockid,
												type,
												transno,
												loccode,
												trandate,
												debtorno,
												branchcode,
												prd,
												reference,
												qty,
												standardcost,
												show_on_inv_crds,
												newqoh)
									VALUES ('" . $AssParts['component'] . "',
											 10,
											 '" . $InvoiceNo . "',
											 '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "',
											 '" . $DefaultDispatchDate . "',
											 '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
											 '" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
											 '" . $PeriodNo . "',
											 '" . __('Assembly') . ': ' . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . ' ' . __('Order') . ': ' . $OrderNo . "',
											 '" . -$AssParts['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
											 '" . $AssParts['standard'] . "',
											 0,
											 '" . ($QtyOnHandPrior - $AssParts['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "'	)";

				$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

				$SQL = "UPDATE locstock
						SET quantity = locstock.quantity - " . ($AssParts['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "
						WHERE locstock.stockid = '" . $AssParts['component'] . "'
						AND loccode = '" . $OrderHeader['fromlocstk'] . "'";

				$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
			} /* end of assembly explosion and updates */
		} /* end of its an assembly */


		if ($OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='A' OR $OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='D'){
			/*it's a Dummy/Service item or an Assembly item - still need stock movement record
			 * but quantites on hand are always nil */
			$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmoves (stockid,
											type,
											transno,
											loccode,
											trandate,
											debtorno,
											branchcode,
											price,
											prd,
											reference,
											qty,
											discountpercent,
											standardcost,
											newqoh)
					VALUES ('" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "',
							'10',
							'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
							'" . $LocalCurrencyPrice . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $OrderNo . "',
							'" . -$OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
							'" . $OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] . "',
							'" . $StandardCost . "',
							'0' )";

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
		}
		/*Get the ID of the StockMove... */
		$StkMoveNo = DB_Last_Insert_ID('stockmoves','stkmoveno');
		/*Insert the taxes that applied to this line */
		foreach ($LineTaxes[$LineCounter] as $Tax) {

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmovestaxes (stkmoveno,
								taxauthid,
								taxrate,
								taxcalculationorder,
								taxontax)
					VALUES ('" . $StkMoveNo . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxAuthID'] . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxRate'] . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxCalculationOrder'] . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxOnTax'] . "')";

			$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
		}

		/*Insert Sales Analysis records */

		$SQL="SELECT COUNT(*),
					salesanalysis.stkcategory,
					salesanalysis.area,
					salesanalysis.salesperson,
					salesanalysis.periodno,
					salesanalysis.typeabbrev,
					salesanalysis.cust,
					salesanalysis.custbranch,
					salesanalysis.stockid
				FROM salesanalysis,
					custbranch,
					stockmaster
				WHERE salesanalysis.stkcategory=stockmaster.categoryid
				AND salesanalysis.stockid=stockmaster.stockid
				AND salesanalysis.cust=custbranch.debtorno
				AND salesanalysis.custbranch=custbranch.branchcode
				AND salesanalysis.area=custbranch.area
				AND salesanalysis.salesperson=custbranch.salesman
				AND salesanalysis.typeabbrev ='" . $OrderHeader['ordertype'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.periodno='" . $PeriodNo . "'
				AND salesanalysis.cust " . LIKE . "  '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.custbranch  " . LIKE . " '" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.stockid  " . LIKE . " '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.budgetoractual='1'
				GROUP BY salesanalysis.stockid,
					salesanalysis.stkcategory,
					salesanalysis.cust,
					salesanalysis.custbranch,
					salesanalysis.area,
					salesanalysis.periodno,
					salesanalysis.typeabbrev,
					salesanalysis.salesperson";

		$ErrMsg = __('The count of existing Sales analysis records could not run because');
		$Result = DB_query($SQL, $ErrMsg, '', true);

		$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);

		if ($MyRow[0]>0){  /*Update the existing record that already exists */

			$SQL = "UPDATE salesanalysis
					SET amt=amt+" . filter_number_format($OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] / $OrderHeader['rate']) . ",
					qty=qty +" . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . ",
					disc=disc+" . filter_number_format($OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] * $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] / $OrderHeader['rate']) . "
					WHERE salesanalysis.area='" . $MyRow[2] . "'
					AND salesanalysis.salesperson='" . $MyRow[3] . "'
					AND typeabbrev ='" . $OrderHeader['ordertype'] . "'
					AND periodno = '" . $PeriodNo . "'
					AND cust  " . LIKE . " '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "'
					AND custbranch  " . LIKE . "  '" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "'
					AND stockid  " . LIKE . " '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
					AND salesanalysis.stkcategory ='" . $MyRow[1] . "'
					AND budgetoractual='1'";

		} else { /* insert a new sales analysis record */

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO salesanalysis (	typeabbrev,
												periodno,
												amt,
												cost,
												cust,
												custbranch,
												qty,
												disc,
												stockid,
												area,
												budgetoractual,
												salesperson,
												stkcategory )
							SELECT '" . $OrderHeader['ordertype']. "',
								'" . $PeriodNo . "',
								'" . $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] / $OrderHeader['rate'] . "',
								0,
								'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
								'" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
								'" . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
								'" . $OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] * $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] / $OrderHeader['rate'] . "',
								'" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "',
								custbranch.area,
								1,
								custbranch.salesman,
								stockmaster.categoryid
							FROM stockmaster, custbranch
							WHERE stockmaster.stockid = '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
							AND custbranch.debtorno = '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "'
							AND custbranch.branchcode='" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "'";

		}

function GetCurrentPeriod () {

	$TransDate = time(); //The current date to find the period for
	/* Find the unix timestamp of the last period end date in periods table */
	$SQL = "SELECT MAX(lastdate_in_period), MAX(periodno) from periods";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);

	if (is_null($MyRow[0])){
		$InsertFirstPeriodResult = api_DB_query("INSERT INTO periods VALUES (0,'" . Date('Y-m-d',mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+1,0,Date('Y'))) . "')");
		$InsertFirstPeriodResult = api_DB_query("INSERT INTO periods VALUES (1,'" . Date('Y-m-d',mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+2,0,Date('Y'))) . "')");
		$LastPeriod=1;
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+2,0,Date('Y'));
	} else {
		$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1]+1,0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
		$LastPeriod = $MyRow[1];
	}
	/* Find the unix timestamp of the first period end date in periods table */
	$SQL = "SELECT MIN(lastdate_in_period), MIN(periodno) from periods";
	$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);
	$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);
	$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
	$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1],0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
	$FirstPeriod = $MyRow[1];

	/* If the period number doesn't exist */
	if (!PeriodExists($TransDate)) {
		/* if the transaction is after the last period */
		if ($TransDate > $LastPeriodEnd) {

			$PeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $TransDate)+1, 0, Date('Y', $TransDate));

			while ($PeriodEnd >= $LastPeriodEnd) {
				if (Date('m', $LastPeriodEnd)<=13) {
					$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $LastPeriodEnd)+2, 0, Date('Y', $LastPeriodEnd));
				} else {
					$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,2, 0, Date('Y', $LastPeriodEnd)+1);
				}
				$LastPeriod++;
				CreatePeriod($LastPeriod, $LastPeriodEnd);
			}
		} else {
		/* The transaction is before the first period */
			$PeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $TransDate), 0, Date('Y', $TransDate));
			$Period = $FirstPeriod - 1;
			while ($FirstPeriodEnd > $PeriodEnd) {
				CreatePeriod($Period, $FirstPeriodEnd);
				$Period--;
				if (Date('m', $FirstPeriodEnd)>0) {
					$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $FirstPeriodEnd), 0, Date('Y', $FirstPeriodEnd));
				} else {
					$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,13, 0, Date('Y', $FirstPeriodEnd));
				}
			}
		}
	} elseif (!PeriodExists(mktime(0,0,0,Date('m',$TransDate)+1,Date('d',$TransDate),Date('Y',$TransDate)))) {
		/* Make sure the following months period exists */
		$SQL = "SELECT MAX(lastdate_in_period), MAX(periodno) from periods";
		$Result = DB_query($SQL);
		$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);
		$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1]+2,0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
		$LastPeriod = $MyRow[1];
		CreatePeriod($LastPeriod+1, $LastPeriodEnd);
	}

	/* Now return the period number of the transaction */

	$MonthAfterTransDate = Mktime(0,0,0,Date('m',$TransDate)+1,Date('d',$TransDate),Date('Y',$TransDate));
	$GetPrdSQL = "SELECT periodno
					FROM periods
					WHERE lastdate_in_period < '" . Date('Y-m-d', $MonthAfterTransDate) . "'
					AND lastdate_in_period >= '" . Date('Y-m-d', $TransDate) . "'";

	$ErrMsg = __('An error occurred in retrieving the period number');
	$GetPrdResult = DB_query($GetPrdSQL, $ErrMsg);
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($GetPrdResult);

	return $MyRow[0];
}
